scope.description: Current TileLang TPU frontend/internal operation contract for BM1690 TPU-Kernel and SG2260E TPU-Kernel/RV, with evidence scoped by dtype, variant, target, and execution mode.
excluded_claims: A passed row does not imply support for shapes, layouts, dtypes, transpose modes, broadcast modes, scheduling modes, or aliases outside its stated scope.
Source-only code generation success does not imply PPL/device compilation, CModel numerical correctness, or PCIe execution.
CModel success does not imply PCIe success, multicore scaling, hazard-free software pipelining, or performance optimality.
An SDK declaration does not imply that the TileLang frontend or code generator exposes it.
Ignored runtime artifacts are local evidence and may not exist in another clone.

invariants.expression: every buffer operand crosses the typed TPU semantic ABI as tl.region(BufferLoad, access_mask, logical_extents); non-copy operations require a zero-min whole-buffer region whose dtype, source rank, normalized shape, scope, and storage identity match a compiler-owned descriptor; copy validates its explicitly selected subregion
invariants.description: The former bare access_ptr ABI lost a T.view/T.reshape alias's logical shape. The region ABI preserves that metadata until native validation, rejects rank/shape-changing aliases rather than executing the owner descriptor silently, and has no compatibility path for bare access_ptr operands. A presentation alias with exactly the owned descriptor remains semantically equivalent.

support_status.supported: The exact selector has evidence-backed TileLang code generation; numerical stages remain independently scoped.
support_status.unsupported: The exact selector is intentionally absent or rejected at some required TileLang stage.
support_status.unverified: A plausible or declared TileLang route exists, but exact code generation has not been demonstrated.
support_status.experimental: A route exists but has a semantic, safety, or fail-closed gap and must not be consumed as supported by default.

stage_status.passed: The exact stage and scope are supported by referenced evidence.
stage_status.historical_passed: The exact PCIe stage and recorded scope passed on an older implementation baseline, but it cannot authorize the current implementation for board execution.
stage_status.failed: Referenced source or experiment proves that the exact selector cannot pass this stage.
stage_status.unverified: No qualifying evidence has been recorded for this exact stage and scope.
stage_status.not_applicable: An earlier required stage rejects the selector, or the target/backend does not define this stage.

implementation_conformance.conforming: Current rejection or implementation matches the stated contract and fails closed where required.
implementation_conformance.known_gap: Current code has an acceptance, validation, diagnostic, or semantic gap described by the row.
implementation_conformance.unverified: Conformance has not been established by a narrow review or test.
implementation_conformance.not_applicable: No current implementation is expected for this selector.

vocabulary.declared_semantics: verification.declared describes reachability through the current public TileLang frontend for the exact selector. A direct internal ABI codegen experiment may pass while declared fails; that mismatch must be marked implementation_conformance=known_gap. verification.sdk_declared records only the underlying PPL, TPU-Kernel, or RV ISA declaration.

targets.reason: BM1690 is registered with the TPU-Kernel programming model only.
The target registry rejects RV for BM1690; no operation row may claim this pair.

operations.semantics: Copy one static region from src to dst; if local src/dst dtypes differ, the operation may be a copy-and-convert selector.

notes: AddressAssign models src as read and dst as write.

constraints.expression: 1 <= rank(src_region) <= 4 and 1 <= rank(dst_region) <= 4; normalize r1->[1,1,1,W], r2->[1,C,1,W], r3->[N,C,1,W], and retain r4, then require normalized_extent(src) == normalized_extent(dst)
constraints.description: Source and destination may have different original ranks; each static region lowers independently to one N/C/H/W descriptor before normalized extents are compared. A full rank-3 transfer is emitted as one descriptor operation; local subregions must start at C=0 because a linear LMEM offset cannot encode an arbitrary channel-lane slice.

constraints.expression: each operand scope is global or one of {shared,shared.dyn,local,local.fragment}; every normalized descriptor and region extent is a compile-time integer in [1,65535]
constraints.description: Unsupported scopes, symbolic dimensions, zero dimensions, and dimensions above the inclusive TPUv7/PPL dim4 bound fail before source emission.

constraints.expression: normalized_extent(src) == normalized_extent(dst)
constraints.description: The copy has no implicit reshape or tail mask.

constraints.expression: 0 <= region_min and region_min + extent <= buffer_shape
constraints.description: Statically unprovable or out-of-bounds regions fail closed.

constraints.expression: src_dtype != dst_dtype implies both operands are local and either (backend==tpukernel and the directed pair is FP32<->{FP16,BF16,FP8E4M3,FP8E5M2}) or (backend==rv and src_dtype,dst_dtype are distinct members of {FP16,BF16,FP32})
constraints.description: DMA paths do not convert. TPU-Kernel selects only the reviewed FP32-peer cast pairs; RV selects rvt_cvt_f2f only for its three mapped base floating formats. Integer and every other mixed pair fail closed.

constraints.expression: an FP8 src or dst implies backend == tpukernel; differing dtypes additionally require the other dtype to be float32
constraints.description: Current TPU-Kernel supports same-format FP8 transport and local FP32<->FP8 cast only; RV and every other FP8 cast pair fail closed.

failure_policy.condition: Unsupported dtype pair, memory-scope pair, extent, or bounds
failure_policy.diagnostic: Reject before emitting or compiling a partial transfer.

operations.semantics: Broadcast a compile-time floating literal into every element of a local destination tile.

constraints.expression: scope(dst) in {shared,shared.dyn,local,local.fragment}
constraints.description: Global fill and every non-descriptor allocation scope are outside the portable contract and fail closed across frontend and codegen checks.

constraints.expression: every normalized N/C/H/W extent is a compile-time integer in [1,65535]
constraints.description: Zero, symbolic, or over-limit local allocation dimensions are rejected before emission.

constraints.expression: value is FloatImm
constraints.description: Dynamic scalar materialization is not implemented.

constraints.expression: backend == rv implies value == 0.0
constraints.description: RV currently materializes only accumulator zero.

constraints.expression: dtype(dst) in {e4m3_float8,e5m2_float8} implies backend == tpukernel and value == 0.0
constraints.description: Only the all-zero FP8 bit pattern is selected; FP8 nonzero scalar materialization and every RV FP8 fill fail closed.

failure_policy.condition: Unsupported dtype or nonlocal dst
failure_policy.diagnostic: Reject before forming tl.tpu.fill.

failure_policy.condition: Dynamic literal, nonzero RV literal, nonzero FP8 literal, or invalid descriptor extent
failure_policy.diagnostic: Reject target-specific unsupported forms before instruction emission.

operations.semantics: Compute C = A @ B or C += A @ B on local two-dimensional tiles, with explicit transpose and accumulation attributes.

parameters.name: transpose_a
parameters.description: Compile-time left transpose flag; true is unsupported.

parameters.name: accumulate
parameters.description: Mandatory semantic bit selecting overwrite or accumulation.

notes: The explicit accumulate bit prevents backend defaults from changing AddressAssign effects.

constraints.expression: A,B,C are local rank-2 tiles whose recovered N=1 and H=1
constraints.description: The portable mapping is a 2-D matrix contract, not arbitrary rank-4 GEMM.

constraints.expression: A=(M,K), B logical layout=(K,N) or stored B shape=(N,K) when transpose_B==true, C=(M,N)
constraints.description: K agreement is checked in the frontend and full shapes in codegen; 'stored shape' does not imply support for T.view/T.reshape aliases.

constraints.expression: storage(C) != storage(A) and storage(C) != storage(B)
constraints.description: The output/accumulator must not alias either input. The public helper and native semantic boundary both reject identity aliases; A and B may share storage because both are read-only.
Descriptor and TPU-Kernel dimensions are uint16 bounded.

constraints.expression: transpose_A == false
constraints.description: The public helper rejects left transpose before target-specific selection.

constraints.expression: for matching FP16/BF16 A and B, accumulate requires FP32 C while overwrite permits FP32 C or C matching A/B
constraints.description: The frontend and both code generators preserve the distinction between the result dtype and the accumulation semantic bit; FP32 overwrite is legal but not yet numerically verified.

constraints.expression: transpose_B == true and accumulate == true requires FP32 C and either an RV FP16/BF16 fmm2a_nt selector or a TPU-Kernel same-format FP8 _R_trans selector
constraints.description: The target-independent frontend preserves explicit accumulation. TPU-Kernel base-float right-transpose rejects it, RV base-float selects fmm2a_nt, and TPU-Kernel FP8 selects _R_trans with result_add=true.

constraints.expression: dtype(A)==dtype(B) in {e4m3_float8,e5m2_float8} implies backend == tpukernel and dtype(C)==float32
constraints.description: The frontend fixes FP8 output/accumulation to FP32; TPU-Kernel selects its fp8_mm family while RV remains fail-closed.

failure_policy.condition: Nonlocal/non-rank-2 input, invalid input or C dtype, transpose_A, K mismatch, or non-boolean/omitted accumulate
failure_policy.diagnostic: Reject before forming an invalid target-independent GEMM semantic call.

failure_policy.condition: Target-specific dtype/layout/accumulation selector, full shape, or descriptor dimension is unsupported
failure_policy.diagnostic: Fail closed before instruction emission; never silently change overwrite/accumulate semantics.

operations.semantics: Elementwise out = lhs / rhs on local 2-D tiles; RV uses the ISA reciprocal-square-root approximation path configured for three iterations.

constraints.expression: out,lhs,rhs are local rank-2 tiles with recovered N=1,H=1
constraints.description: Only the 2-D mapping is supported.

constraints.expression: shape(out)==shape(lhs) and (shape(rhs)==shape(out) or shape(rhs)==(M,1))

constraints.description: The current RV instruction is approximate and is not a strict IEEE division contract.

operations.semantics: Compute elementwise out = maximum(lhs, rhs) on local rank-2 tiles, with optional rhs W broadcast.

parameters.name: rhs
parameters.description: Right input tile or shape-(M,1) W-broadcast tile.

constraints.expression: out,lhs,rhs are local rank-2 tiles with recovered N=1,H=1
constraints.description: The public portable semantic accepts only local two-dimensional tiles.

constraints.expression: shape(out)==shape(lhs) and (shape(rhs)==shape(out) or shape(rhs)==(M,1))
constraints.description: Only equal-shape elementwise maximum and rhs W broadcast are accepted.

constraints.expression: dtype(out)==dtype(lhs)==dtype(rhs) and (dtype(out) in {float16,bfloat16,float32} or (backend==tpukernel and dtype(out) in {e4m3_float8,e5m2_float8}))
constraints.description: The public semantic accepts the two FP8 formats because target selection follows frontend construction. TPU-Kernel lowers them through generic tpu_bdc_max; RV Tensor rejects FP8 at codegen and remains fail-closed.

operations.semantics: Compute out = inp + value or out = inp * value using a compile-time floating literal.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Selects add or multiply; scalar sub/div are not exposed.

constraints.expression: out and inp are local, same-shape, same-dtype tiles
constraints.description: Only one-to-one scalar broadcast is exposed.

constraints.expression: value is FloatImm
constraints.description: Dynamic scalar input is unsupported.

operations.semantics: Compute natural exp in place in out using two same-shape scratch tiles and a PPL 1.7 dtype-specific coefficient buffer.

notes: AddressAssign intentionally models all operands conservatively because the composite TPU-Kernel helper mutates scratch and coefficients.

constraints.expression: out,work0,work1,coeff are local and share one dtype
constraints.description: Current PPL 1.7 path accepts FP16, BF16, or FP32 only.

constraints.expression: shape4(out)==shape4(work0)==shape4(work1) and shape(coeff)==(64,32)
constraints.description: Frontend and codegen compare complete normalized N/C/H/W shapes; the no-table PPL 1.7 composite uses a fixed dtype-matching 64x32 coefficient tile.

constraints.expression: storage(out),storage(work0),storage(work1),storage(coeff) are pairwise distinct
constraints.description: The composite mutates output, workspaces, and coefficient storage; aliasing would invalidate its opaque effect schedule.

constraints.expression: every normalized N/C/H/W extent is a compile-time integer in [1,65535] and H*W <= 65535
constraints.description: The additional product bound is required by tpu_bdc_fp_exp and is checked after full-shape equality.

failure_policy.condition: selected programming_model is not tpukernel
failure_policy.diagnostic: Reject the explicit tl.tpukernel.exp semantic operation before target-specific passes.

failure_policy.condition: FP8/other dtype, nonlocal operand, mismatched work shape, storage alias, or unsupported arity
failure_policy.diagnostic: Use the four-buffer PPL 1.7 exp ABI only.

operations.semantics: Compute out = 1 / (1 + exp(-inp)) through the PPL 1.7 no-table composite with two payload-sized work tiles and one fixed coefficient tile.

parameters.name: coeff
parameters.description: PPL 1.7 coefficient storage with shape (64,32); there is no table operand.

notes: These are the composite's semantic effects. AddressAssign additionally places all five operands, including inp and out, in one conservative bank-conflict clique because it cannot see through the opaque instruction sequence.

constraints.expression: signature is (out,inp,work0,work1,coeff), with no lookup-table operand
constraints.description: The PPL 1.7 composition loads generic exp coefficients and exposes exactly five buffers.

constraints.expression: out,inp,work0,work1 are local, same-dtype, complete-shape4-equal tiles in {float16,bfloat16,float32}; coeff has the same dtype and shape (64,32)
constraints.description: Frontend and codegen both fail closed on dtype, locality, complete N/C/H/W payload shape, and coefficient extent.

constraints.expression: storage(out),storage(inp),storage(work0),storage(work1),storage(coeff) are pairwise distinct
constraints.description: The public composite rejects every storage alias before forming its five-buffer semantic call.

constraints.expression: every normalized N/C/H/W extent is a compile-time integer in [1,65535] and H*W <= 65535
constraints.description: The composite invokes tpu_bdc_fp_exp and therefore inherits its H*W product bound.

failure_policy.condition: selected programming_model is not tpukernel
failure_policy.diagnostic: Reject the explicit tl.tpukernel.sigmoid semantic operation before target-specific passes.

failure_policy.condition: FP8/other dtype, nonlocal operand, mismatched payload/work shape, wrong coefficient shape, storage alias, or unsupported arity
failure_policy.diagnostic: Use only the five-buffer PPL 1.7 no-table signature.

notes: Source inspection proves the ABI and selector exist, but no independent compile or numerical result is inferred from source alone.

operations.semantics: Compute out = 1 / sqrt(inp) for same-shape local FP16, BF16, or FP32 tiles through the generic TPU-Kernel floating rsqrt primitive.

constraints.expression: dtype(out)==dtype(inp) in {float16,bfloat16,float32}
constraints.description: The generic tpu_bdc_fp_rsqrt mapping covers the three base floating dtypes; FP8 and integers fail closed.

constraints.expression: out and inp are local and shape-equal
constraints.description: No broadcast form exists.

failure_policy.condition: selected programming_model is not tpukernel
failure_policy.diagnostic: Reject the explicit tl.tpukernel.rsqrt semantic operation before target-specific passes.

failure_policy.condition: dtype outside FP16/BF16/FP32, nonlocal operand, or shape mismatch

operations.semantics: Reduce each row of a local 2-D tile along dim=1 into a shape-(M,1) output, using a pool-based two-stage composite and temporary local storage.

parameters.name: inp
parameters.description: Input tile; current lowering may initialize its physically padded tail.

notes: Input read_write is intentional in AddressAssign because the current composite can write the physically padded tail.

constraints.expression: rank(inp)==rank(out)==2 and dim==1 and shape(out)==(shape(inp)[0],1)
constraints.description: Only row reduction is exposed.

constraints.expression: inp/out are local, same dtype, and one of float16,bfloat16,float32
constraints.description: Integer branches remaining in the internal sum code are unreachable through the public helper and are not contractual.

constraints.expression: storage(inp), storage(out), and compiler-owned storage(tmp) are pairwise distinct
constraints.description: The composite writes the padded input tail and scratch tile, so neither may alias the result or each other. Public inp/out identity and the complete native triple are checked independently.

constraints.expression: the lowering owns temporary storage and may initialize aligned tail elements
constraints.description: Consumers must not assume input padding is preserved.

constraints.expression: every normalized input/output extent is a compile-time integer in [1,65535], and the EU-aligned padded width is also <= 65535
constraints.description: A legal original width may align upward to 65536; that derived padded descriptor is rejected before emission.

failure_policy.diagnostic: Reject explicit tl.tpukernel.reduce_* operations before target-specific passes.

failure_policy.condition: unsupported dtype/rank/axis/output shape
failure_policy.diagnostic: Reject statically invalid public reduce forms before emission.

failure_policy.condition: insufficient local storage after temporary allocation
failure_policy.diagnostic: Fail compilation instead of dispatching an invalid local-memory layout.

operations.semantics: Gather rows from global param into global output using global uint32 indices and a positive compile-time param_h.

constraints.expression: output,param,index are global
constraints.description: Current mapping selects S2S gather only.

constraints.expression: dtype(output)==dtype(param) in {float16,bfloat16,float32,e4m3_float8,e5m2_float8} and dtype(index)==uint32
constraints.description: Frontend and TPU-Kernel codegen share this floating-payload whitelist; integer payloads fail closed.

constraints.expression: storage(output),storage(param),storage(index) are pairwise distinct
constraints.description: The S2S gather contract does not define in-place or index/payload aliasing.

constraints.expression: param=(param_h,width), output=(count,width), index=(count,1), and param_h>0 is a compile-time integer
constraints.description: Frontend and codegen structurally validate ranks and extents required by tpu_gdma_h_gather_S2S.

constraints.expression: 0 <= index[i,0] < param_h for every i
constraints.description: Index values are runtime data; callers must satisfy the DMA primitive's range precondition.

failure_policy.condition: selected programming_model is not tpukernel
failure_policy.diagnostic: Reject the explicit tl.tpukernel.gather semantic operation before target-specific passes.

failure_policy.condition: unsupported payload/index dtype, non-global operand, storage alias, malformed shape, or invalid param_h
failure_policy.diagnostic: Reject statically invalid S2S gather forms; runtime index bounds remain a caller precondition.

operations.semantics: Select the ascending or descending top-K prefix from a global source of compile-time length and write exactly K values plus their natural int32 indices; equal keys preserve increasing natural-index order in the verified BM1690 implementation.

notes: Both outputs have extent K. Earlier length-sized sentinel tests showed the primitive writes only [0,K), which justifies the exact K-sized public contract.

constraints.expression: dst_data,dst_idx,src are global
constraints.description: Current HAU path operates on system memory addresses.

constraints.expression: dtype(dst_data)==dtype(src) in {float32,int32,uint32} and dtype(dst_idx)==int32
constraints.description: FP8/FP16/BF16 payloads and non-int32 index outputs are rejected.

constraints.expression: storage(dst_data),storage(dst_idx),storage(src) are pairwise distinct
constraints.description: The HAU natural-index ABI does not define in-place or value/index aliasing.

constraints.expression: 0 < K <= length
constraints.description: K and length must be positive compile-time integers.

constraints.expression: src is rank-1 with extent length; dst_data and dst_idx are rank-1 with extent K
constraints.description: Current frontend capacity matches the observed BM1690 write extent. Length-sized sentinel characterization proved that the HAU primitive does not write the output tail after K.

constraints.expression: target_chip == bm1690
constraints.description: PPL tpub_7_1_e exposes the symbol in its header but its SG2260E runtime implementation always rejects the HAU natural-index primitive.

failure_policy.condition: selected programming_model is not tpukernel
failure_policy.diagnostic: Reject the explicit tl.tpukernel.topk semantic operation before target-specific passes.

failure_policy.condition: unsupported dtype, non-global or non-vector operand, storage alias, invalid K/length, or incompatible buffer extents
failure_policy.diagnostic: Reject every statically invalid HAU natural-index sort form before emission.

failure_policy.condition: target chip is SG2260E
failure_policy.diagnostic: Report that tpu_hau_sort_natural_index is unavailable on SG2260E; never dispatch it to CModel or PCIe.

operations.semantics: Assemble interleaved RoPE output by adding two precomputed even terms and two precomputed odd terms into alternating lanes.

constraints.expression: all five buffers are local, rank-2, same-shape, and same-dtype
constraints.description: The composite assumes aligned corresponding lanes.

constraints.expression: the common dtype is one of {float16,bfloat16,float32,e4m3_float8,e5m2_float8}
constraints.description: The public helper and TPU-Kernel codegen expose the same base-float and FP8 set.

constraints.expression: storage(out) is distinct from each input storage; input storages may alias one another
constraints.description: The composite writes alternating lanes in out while reading all four inputs; only read/read aliasing is accepted.

constraints.expression: shape(out)[-1] % 2 == 0
constraints.description: Frontend rejects odd W; codegen redundantly checks it before constructing alternating-lane views.

failure_policy.condition: selected programming_model is not tpukernel
failure_policy.diagnostic: Reject the explicit tl.tpukernel.rope_add semantic operation before target-specific passes.
